description: 🔥 Risk Matrix Viz: Visualise Risk Likelihood and Impact in Power BI The Risk Matrix Viz is a custom visual designed to streamline the visualisation of risk likelihood and impact in Power BI. Risk Matrices are used globally by project managers to manage risk across diverse industries, from cyber security to mining. The Risk Matrix Viz allows business users to accelerate the visualisation of a risk matrix and bypass tedious setups. 🚀 Key Features Effortless Drag & Drop: Quickly create a risk matrix by simply dragging and dropping fields from your dataset. No more complicated configurations! Flexible Grid Dimensions: The Risk Matrix Viz dimensions can be customised to suit your needs. Most project management users opt for 3x3, 4x4, or 5x5, but the option is yours — up to a maximum of 9x9 matrix cells. Unconventional layouts such as 9x3 or 4x7 are also supported. Risk Levels are set independently of Rows and Columns for maximum flexibility. Set your own number of Risk Levels and name them to suit your case. Dynamic Color Customization: 🎨 Turn on Use Gradient Colors to view a color transition from low to high in gradient style as an alternative to solid colors. Add a customisable Data Circle, change the color of your data values, make them bold or underlined.
